children: ) is pleased to congratulate Tanya Hart, Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer, on being named the 2026 Distinguished Alumnus of the Year by Leadership Memphis. Since 1979, Leadership Memphis has honored visionary community leaders whose impact resonates throughout the region.

"Tanya's leadership extends far beyond the walls of our organization," said Bryan Jordan, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer of First Horizon. "She began her remarkable journey with us as a teller, rising to shape the Human Resources strategy for our entire company. Her unwavering commitment is also clearly felt throughout the Memphis community. Tanya leads with authenticity and purpose, and we are proud to celebrate her continued dedication to our team and our region."

Hart's devotion to civic leadership is demonstrated through her role as executive member and secretary on the Brooks Museum of Art Board. She has previously served on the boards of Junior Achievement of Memphis, New Memphis Institute, University of Memphis Foundation, First 8 Memphis and was the 2026 honorary chair of the DeNeuville Learning Center for Women gala.

Her professional accolades include Memphis Business Journal's Super Women in Business and HR Impact Awards, Savoy Magazine's Most Influential Black Executives in Corporate America (2022 and 2024) and American Banker's Most Powerful Women in Banking team honors (2022 and 2024).
